pricing.faq_subtitle: Have questions about VSME reporting or our platform? Find quick answers below.
pricing.faq_a1: VSME (Voluntary Sustainability for Micro and Small Enterprises) reporting is a framework developed by the EU to help small and medium-sized businesses report on their sustainability practices and performance. It follows simplified standards compared to the more comprehensive CSRD (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) required for larger companies.
pricing.faq_q2: How long does it take to implement your platform?
pricing.faq_a2: Most SMBs can get started with our platform in just 1-2 days. Our guided setup process walks you through each step, and our support team is available to help with any questions. The actual reporting process becomes significantly faster once you're set up in the system.
pricing.faq_q3: What if I don't have experience with sustainability reporting?
pricing.faq_a3: Our platform is specifically designed for businesses without prior experience with sustainability reporting. The system provides step-by-step guidance, explanations of key concepts, and templates tailored to your industry. Our support team includes sustainability experts who can answer your questions.
pricing.faq_a4: We offer flexible pricing plans based on business size and reporting needs. Custom enterprise plans are available for businesses with more complex requirements. All plans include regular updates to stay compliant with changing regulations.
pricing.faq_q5: Can I export reports to share with stakeholders?
pricing.faq_a5: Yes, you can easily export your full sustainability reports in multiple formats including PDF and Excel. This makes it easy to share with stakeholders, investors, banks, or customers who require documentation of your sustainability initiatives.
